claims.statement: The move-work procedure applies to FPT, GHEC and GHES >=3.21, distinct from GHES<3.21 legacy personal-account conversion. It transfers repositories/projects to a new or existing organization rather than asserting full identity or credential migration.

Reusing the current personal username for a new organization is optional and requires renaming the personal account first, then creating the organization under the old name. Separately reviewed rename risks and namespace retirement conditions remain relevant; the sequence is not guaranteed name availability or authorization.

Settings and Organizations navigation lead to Move work to an organization; prompts select repositories/projects and assign new locations, then confirm movement and navigate to the organization. UI completion does not establish data parity, permissions, security configuration or verified recovery.
Cloud plan guidance is a separate link, not permission to incur costs or select a plan. Target plan and available features require independent applicability review.

Membership guidance branches between cloud invitations and GHES adding people, followed by a common ownership-continuity reference. Moving data does not itself prove membership or accountable ownership continuity.
No personal rename, organization creation, repository/project transfer or protection change is performed; linked plans, membership and ownership guides are not reviewed through this receipt.
